## TransferStore.receiveUpload() method

Receive an upload's bytes and mark it complete. An upload is received once; an interrupted receive (the source throws or the signal aborts) deletes the partial bytes and leaves the upload awaiting bytes again. If the process ends mid-receive, nothing can reset the upload: it stays `receiving` (unreceivable, and holding one of the subject's outstanding slots) until it expires and the sweep removes it with its partial bytes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
receiveUpload(subject: string, uploadId: string, bytes: UploadByteSource, options?: ReceiveUploadOptions): Promise<ReceivedUpload>;
```

## Exceptions

TransferError `unknown-transfer` when the upload is unknown, belongs to another subject, was already received (or is being received), or was consumed meanwhile; `expired` when it expires before the last byte arrives; `too-large` when the bytes exceed the upload's limit or the subject's outstanding-bytes limit, which also marks the upload failed. In every case the partial bytes are deleted.

The source's own error, or the signal's reason, when the receive is interrupted.

Error "The transfer store could not stage the upload." when writing the bytes to disk fails; the filesystem error is its `cause`<!-- -->.
